name: Northridge Valley Wedding and Event Center
description: A 1981 barn and carriage house in northeast Mapleton, renovated in 2021, with mountain views, two lawns for ceremonies, a main hall seating up to 200, an 1888 pioneer cabin, and an included in-house planner.
priceText: Home page $5,000–$6,000; pricing page up to $7,000 (range spans both pages)

Audio/Visual > Sound system.wording: Bluetooth sound systems and party speaker

Features > Outdoors.wording: East & West Lawns for ceremonies and social hours.

Features > Sparklers allowed.wording: Sparklers are allowed on front patio - torches provided.

Decor > Draping / chair covers.wording: Draping from $250 (sheer curtain with lights and up)

Other > Cake table.wording: Cake, buffet, gift and sign-in tables with linens

items.label: Description
items.value: A 1981 barn and carriage house in northeast Mapleton, renovated in 2021, with mountain views, two lawns for ceremonies, a main hall seating up to 200, an 1888 pioneer cabin, and an included in-house planner.

items.label: Price
items.value: Home page $5,000–$6,000; pricing page up to $7,000 (range spans both pages)

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Venue rental (tables and chairs for 200, Something Borrowed decor room with basic decor setup, 5 linens, ceremony arch with drapes and chair setup, sound system, mic, TV on wheels, lawn games, sparkler torches, in-house coordinator, bride's and groom's rooms)
Utah sales tax applies

items.label: Outdoors
items.value: East & West Lawns for ceremonies and social hours.

items.label: Fireplace (indoor)
items.value: Setting: indoor · Notes: smaller guest count

items.label: Upstairs overflow
items.value: Setting: indoor · Notes: round tables for extra seating

items.label: Rooms
items.value:
Bride's suite with back-lit mirrors, chandelier, mini fridge and en-suite bathroom
Groom's room with mini fridge, full-length mirror, large TV, couch and private bathroom

items.label: Included items
items.value:
12 farmhouse tables (9 ft x 40 in., seat up to 12 each)
Sweetheart table (5-ft farmhouse)
220 crossback chairs
Buffet, cake, gift and sign-in tables
5 linens, color of choice
Table runners
Candles (floating, pillar and tapered)
Card box, bud vases, chalkboard signs and frames
Green garlands and simple silk florals
Cake stands and serving set
Drink dispensers and carafes
Ceremony arch with draping (set up at the chosen site)
14-ft fireplace
Lawn games
Torches for sparkler send-offs
Pioneer cabin (1888)

items.label: Staff & coordination
items.value:
In-house planner and day-of coordinator included (planning meeting, final walkthrough, team lead on the wedding day)
Month Out Coordination (2 team members) — $2,500
Complete Wedding Service (6 months of planning, setup, takedown, day-of coordination) — $5,000

items.label: Setup & cleanup
items.value: Caterers clean the kitchen when finished

items.label: Sound system
items.value: Bluetooth sound systems and party speaker

items.label: Equipment
items.value:
Yes
Bluetooth surround sound system and party box
Microphone and speaker
TV on wheels

items.label: Draping / chair covers
items.value: Draping from $250 (sheer curtain with lights and up)

items.label: For rent
items.value:
Mantle and ceremony backdrop decorating (silk florals and greenery) — $950
Basic greenery — $500
Florals by a floral designer (personal flowers and centerpieces) — from $2,500
Framed backdrops (simple sheer curtain to full draping) — from $250
Drop-off decorating setup (couple's centerpieces, signage, photos, favors) — $500
Additional linens — $20 each
Bar top — $25
Chinaware and glassware — $5 per person ($1 per piece)

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Mountain views
Two lawns (east and west) for ceremonies and social hour
Upstairs overflow seating
Water dispensers
Take-out box delivered to the send-off vehicle
Snow machine — $150
Getaway car (1915 Dodge Brothers touring car, driver provided) — $500
Extra help (2 staff for restocking and clearing tables) — $250

items.label: Cake table
items.value: Cake, buffet, gift and sign-in tables with linens

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Any commercially licensed caterer, any caterer allowed
Food trucks on the vendor list
Popular caterers: Brown Brothers, Utah Celebrations, Marvelous, Magleby's, Culinary Crafts

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value:
Warming kitchen for caterers
Beverage dispensers

items.label: Alcohol
items.value:
$250 fee to bring alcohol
Must use one of two bartending services (COPA or Cheers and Swizzles), unless Culinary Crafts provides its own bartenders

items.label: Sparklers allowed
items.value: Sparklers are allowed on front patio - torches provided.

items.label: Sparklers
items.value:
Yes
Sparklers allowed on the front patio (torches provided)
Cold sparks outdoors only

items.label: Rental length
items.value: 10 hours weekdays; 12 hours Friday and Saturday

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
Events end by 10pm (city noise ordinance)
Sparklers only on the front patio; cold sparks outdoors only
Fireworks only in winter with fire department approval
DJs, bands and musicians must be licensed and insured
Dogs need management approval
Tours by appointment only

items.label: Parking
items.value:
Parking lot with 70 stalls
Overflow parking

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Home page lists a rental range of $5,000-$6,000; the pricing page goes up to $7,000 (Saturday peak)
No minimum guest count; ceremony seating for up to 150
Utah sales tax applies
